decisions.reason: The Small Block changes are independently stated in the source and already represented by its same-message MODIFY; the Big Block trigger change does not further alter Small Block state.
The Big Block draw trigger and qualifying-sale definition do not change the existing per-primary-sale allocations or prize-pool recipients.
The candidate already states that secondary royalties fund the prize pools and do not generate referral tickets; the source does not change its royalty amount or enforcement semantics.
Changing the Big Block draw trigger and funding sources does not alter NFT transfer behavior or the treatment of expired tickets upon transfer.
The Big Block sales-count trigger and pool funding do not change the $5 coded-referral commission, its recipient, timing, or wallet delivery.
The source retains one-click prize claims through the Winners page and does not change the candidate's claim method, announcement channel, or URL.
The Big Block prize trigger does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited primary-mint supply model.
The source continues to state an exact $15 mint price and does not connect the revised Big Block trigger to any pricing change.
The FAQ requirement already uses this complete source message as its baseline copy, so the Big Block wording requires no additional or augmented event.
The Big Block trigger and funding changes do not alter the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
The source's Big Block changes do not alter badge thresholds, award destination, or current cosmetic function.
Big Block remains active and continues to use tickets, so the metadata requirement to expose both Small and Big Block ticket counters remains valid unchanged.
